subject: Compliance platform integration readiness checklist and procurement timing
messages:

Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance platform integration readiness checklist and procurement timing

Hi Alli / Vanta team,

Following our demo last week with Acme, they asked for a combined readiness checklist we can share with their platform and infra teams, plus a high-level procurement timeline (PO, SOW, exec signoff). I pulled together an initial checklist (attached) that mixes security evidence collection items and integration prerequisites.

Can you: 
- Review the checklist and flag items that TrustCenter or Vanta would own versus what Acme needs to provide?
- Confirm typical SOW lead times and whether TrustCenter includes a small implementation block (2-4 days) in standard plans?

I copied Sergio and Rishi for technical and procurement constraints. If this looks good I’ll route a combined doc to Acme procurement with proposed milestones.

Attachments: integration-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Alli Martin <alli.martin@trustcenter.com>

Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance platform integration readiness checklist and procurement timing

Hi Lauren — thanks for the checklist, this is helpful. Quick notes inline: 

- Ownership: TrustCenter can own evidence ingestion connectors (Okta, GCP logs, S3) and the control mapping. Acme will need to provision read-only service accounts and configure log exports; we can provide a template.
- Implementation block: standard plans include a 3-day implementation package (kickoff, connector setup, validation). We can add an optional 2-day accelerated window at an extra cost.
- SOW lead time: once scope is confirmed we typically turn around a SOW in 3-5 business days; procurement + PO varies but customers average 2–4 weeks.

I attached a draft SOW and a sample template for the service-account request. I marked the checklist where TrustCenter can pre-provision.

Attachments: trustcenter-sow-draft.pdf; service-account-template.txt

Best,
Alli Martin
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
TrustCenter
alli.martin@trustcenter.com
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Alli Martin <alli.martin@trustcenter.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-24T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance platform integration readiness checklist and procurement timing

Lauren / Alli — I reviewed the checklist and added a few infra items that will impact timing: 

- Acme must open a dedicated VPC peering window for TrustCenter connectors or provide a bastion host; timeline + infra approvals could add 5–7 business days.
- Log retention queries: our KV cache and tokenization pipelines prefer JSONL exports with timestamps; if Acme exports logs in a different schema we’ll need a normalization step (1–2 days).
- SSO: we can accept SAML or OIDC; if Acme chooses SAML they need to provide metadata earlier (kickoff) to avoid a 3–4 day delay.

Operational ask: please add "network contacts + maintenance window constraints" to the checklist so we can align on firewall and support hours. I also noted which items require privileged access versus read-only.

- Sergio Alvarez
Platform Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Key procurement milestones I included:
- Scope confirmation / SOW signoff: target by 2027-06-03
- PO issuance: target by 2027-06-17
- Kickoff: target week of 2027-06-21
